finding: Confirmed: AMD transmit is J5.4 U_RX via zero-ohm R9558 to NCT6686D pin34 SOUTA; J5.3 U_TX via R9557 to pin33 SINA is input. Header labels are external-adapter viewpoint.

datasheet.output: pin34 SOUTA O12p3 UART A Serial Output
datasheet.voltage_class: O12p3 defined 3.3V in I/O type legend; electrical table inconsistently labels O12p3 as 5V, preserved as source discrepancy

design_voltage_evidence.vendor_output_type: SOUTA pin34 O12p3, defined 3.3V output in section4 legend
design_voltage_evidence.conclusion: 3.3V UART output is documented at design level; isolated contradictory 5V table heading remains source inconsistency, not a measured 5V signal
